# Apple HomePod mini

Control HomePod mini volume, supported existing-session playback, and output groups through Muse Home Link, using compatible local pyatv services when the speaker exposes them; not for starting new audio streams. It honours the speaker's existing access, password and pairing requirements and never weakens them, and it does not recommend play_url for this device.
